purpose: Embed specialization, artist business, marketing/audience and exhibition/opportunity practice through every week of the existing two-year Associates-Level Arts certificate.

rules.separate_course_rule: These are embedded strands inside the two-year certificate, not additional certificate courses.
rules.popularity: Likes, followers and virality are never mastery criteria.
rules.opportunity_verification: Registry discovery is not organizer verification. Confirm all terms on the official opportunity page before applying.
rules.minors: Public posting, client contact and applications by minors follow parent/guardian and Academy safety requirements.
rules.purchasing: No student is required to purchase a product, pay an application fee or enter a paid opportunity for mastery.
rules.registry_application: Students use the operational Bazaar Art Call for Art Registry inside the Exhibition · Clients · Galleries strand. The registry is free, ad-free, has no sponsored ranking, and separates validity checks from community experience reviews.

specialization.title: Specialization Studio I · Exploration & Direction
specialization.weekly_focus: Explore a possible personal direction inside “Artist Portfolio & Baseline Practice” and collect evidence about what deserves deeper study.
daily: Identify one medium, subject, process or problem from this week that deserves deeper exploration.
Compare two possible directions and name the evidence for each.
Run one bounded specialization experiment without abandoning the core lesson.
Transfer the strongest result into a small personal variation or portfolio study.
Archive the experiment, note what felt authentic/useful, and choose what to revisit.

artist_business.weekly_focus: Artist role, working habits & professional identity
artist_business.knowledge: Business knowledge focus: Artist role, working habits & professional identity. Apply the idea to real studio records; purchasing is never required for mastery.
daily: Read the week’s business concept and identify where it already appears in your studio practice.
Audit one existing record, cost, agreement or workflow against the concept.
Build or correct one concrete business record or reusable template.
Use the concept in today’s real Artpreneur/CEO decision and record the result.
Archive the updated record and write the next business action for the coming week.

marketing_brand_audience.weekly_focus: Define what you make and why it matters
marketing_brand_audience.knowledge: Marketing knowledge focus: Define what you make and why it matters. Build an owned, ethical audience practice based on clarity, usefulness and real response rather than likes alone.
daily: Learn the week’s audience/brand principle and identify the communication goal.
